title: docs(agents): a pin-breaking removal ships with the sibling fix and pin bump
body:
Fixes #10986

## What

Encodes the C half of the maintainer's 2026-08-22 A+C ruling (accepted verbatim 「接受所有」) as a working agreement in `AGENTS.md`, Post-Task Checklist item 4:

**A removal that breaks the pinned sibling checkout ships together with the sibling fix and the pin bump — or it does not ship.**

Rationale encoded with the directive: the `Console Pin Gate` job builds objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` against current `main`, so a removal the pinned sibling still imports turns `main` red for every PR in the repo the moment it merges. A ruling that authorizes such a removal therefore implicitly authorizes the objectui-side fix and the pin bump as part of the same landing (including the bump's `sdui:manifest` second half). The item ends with the one-line pre-merge check: does the pinned sibling import what you are removing? `git grep` it in `../objectui` at the pinned SHA.

Placement: new Post-Task Checklist item 4, directly after item 3's retirement paragraph (the prose that points a retirement author at the `spec-property-retirement` skill) and directly before the spec-export-removal item — the PR-flow section a retirement author actually reads. Former items 4-6 renumbered to 5-7; the only externally referenced item number is item 3 (`docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md`, ADR-0115), which is unchanged.

## Line ratchet payment

`AGENTS.md` is ceilinged at 961/961 with zero headroom. The one added line is paid by deleting the seventeen-phantom-pins incident parenthetical in the Build and Test section (the `@ts-expect-error` bullet) — incident case law lives in git history, per the ratchet header's own guidance. After the edit: `check-skill-line-ratchet: AGENTS.md is 961 lines (ceiling 961; headroom 0)` — green, verified at commit `e94c5759`.

## Deferred (declared, not dropped)

The optional one-line pre-merge check in `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` is deferred: PR #11092 is in flight touching that file with auto-merge armed, and creating a conflict with it is worse than a follow-up. The AGENTS.md item carries the same one-line check, so the rule is not silent in the meantime.
